name: DST NIDHI-PRAYAS
agency: Department of Science and Technology (DST), Govt. of India
target_stage: Proof of Concept / Early Prototype to MVP
key_benefits: Access to PRAYAS Shala makerspace, fabrication lab, mentor network, stipend
relevance: Ideal for hardware prototypes built by student teams requiring fabrication and testing.

name: BIRAC Biotechnology Ignition Grant (BIG)
agency: Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC), DBT
key_benefits: Mentoring, institutional lab access, national bio-incubator ecosystem
relevance: Premier grant for medical diagnostics (sickle cell, jaundice, cold chain) and bio-processing.

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
agency: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
key_benefits: Disbursed through approved incubators across India (e.g., 36Inc Raipur)
relevance: Follow-on funding once an entity is incorporated and prototype is validated.

name: MSME Idea Hackathon 3.0
agency: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
key_benefits: Direct funding via Host Institutions (engineering colleges with approved BI status)
relevance: Specifically allows engineering student innovators to apply directly through college.

name: Chhattisgarh Innovation & Startup Seed Grant
agency: Commerce & Industries Dept, Govt of Chhattisgarh (Invest Chhattisgarh)
eligible_domains: Startups registered in Chhattisgarh with local operations
key_benefits: Sustenance allowance (₹20,000/month for founders) + Prototype grant
relevance: Mandatory first stop for any Jagdalpur college startup registered in Chhattisgarh.

name: Bastar District Mineral Foundation (DMF) Innovation Grant
agency: District Collectorate & Bastar DMF Trust, Jagdalpur
target_stage: Pilot deployment solving local high-priority district challenges
key_benefits: Direct procurement and deployment across district Anganwadis, SHCs, and Ashram Shalas
relevance: Fastest route to government field pilot and public procurement right in Bastar.

name: MeitY TIDE 2.0 (Technology Incubation & Development of Entrepreneurs)
agency: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
key_benefits: Fellowship support for student developers and IoT prototyping hardware
relevance: Applicable for embedded IoT, computer vision, and speech kiosks.

name: TRIFED Van Dhan Value Addition Innovation Fund
target_stage: Field deployment in Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVKs)
key_benefits: Direct integration into 300+ VDVKs across Chhattisgarh
relevance: Direct institutional customer and scaling channel for forest produce innovations.

name: NMDC CSR & Sustainable Development Innovation Support
target_stage: Industrial safety, healthcare, local livelihood pilots
key_benefits: Enterprise pilot site access at Nagarnar plant and Bailadila mines
relevance: Local industrial giant with dedicated mandate to uplift Bastar youth and regional safety.

name: Smart India Hackathon (SIH) - Hardware Edition
grant_amount_formatted: ₹1 Lakh (Cash Prize) + Direct Ministry Pilot Pathway
key_benefits: National stage visibility, direct ministry adoption, media coverage
relevance: Premier college competition to validate student hardware prototypes nationally.
